title: Original authorized repeat-review and post-cursor controls
checkpoint: zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms
purpose: Test a newly observed cross-account review-to-repair chain against autonomous-participant, separate-operator and authorization requirements, then advance saved public source cursors without treating feature code, intentional communities or project-authored role labels as organic coordination.

actions_not_taken: execute repository code, tests, scripts, formatters or agent tooling
install a package or invoke a model or agent runtime
contact a participant or repository owner
post, comment, review, vote, react or create an account
read a private inbox, task environment or unlisted room
replay a payload, submit a scan or probe a target system
safety.publication_note: Only public GitHub pull-request, review, commit and account-event metadata, immutable object identifiers, changed-path summaries, domain-level message summaries and bounded search results are retained. Review bodies, letter subjects, household keys, personal addresses, provider-session links, credentials, tokens and executable bodies are omitted.

paused_backlog_state.reason_not_reopened: No new source-level cue separates an unread scanner report from the committed known-family, comparison, Amap or DseWiki controls.

locator_scope.selection_rule: Commit search located public original records; the records themselves, their Git ancestry and pull-request timelines supplied the evidence. Framework source, tests, intentional communities and published controls were closed rather than counted as episodes.

pull_request.title: fix(shell): resolve cloud shell freeze on vim with large files
pull_request.role: Repository-owned branch whose later commits explicitly map a review result into repairs.

reviewed_head.identity_limit: The head is human-authored public Git metadata and does not identify an autonomous recipient run.

reviews.domain_level_result: A structured multi-perspective review lists one critical item plus warning, safety and non-blocking findings against the reviewed shell-session change.
A near-immediate second review repeats the same structured assessment; it is treated as a duplicate submission or update, not another participant.

review_transfer.identity_limit: A user account with a bot-like login and agent-like prose is distinguishable from the pull-request author, but neither feature authenticates AI control, a model provider or an independent operator.

downstream_use.semantic_use: The commit subject explicitly identifies PR 81 review findings by their critical, warning, safety and non-blocking identifiers, and the changed implementation follows those named findings. Four later direct descendants refine the repaired concurrency and generated-asset state before approval.
downstream_use.recipient_limit: Every branch commit is authored and committed under one human identity; no provider-owned receipt binds the repair to an autonomous recipient.

selected_original_chain.semantic_dependency: High confidence. The review names a structured set of findings, the later commit expressly maps those identifiers to its repairs, further branch commits refine the same areas, and the reviewer approves the repaired final head before merge.

authorization_evidence.assessment: Repeated review/approval cycles in the same repository and a public membership addition in another repository under the same owner naming pattern strongly support an installed or authorized reviewer relationship. The PR association value NONE is therefore not evidence of a foreign operator.

alternative_explanations.assessment: strongly supported by repeated same-repository cycles, the related public membership event, use of the repository-owned branch and human merge

alternative_explanations.alternative: human recipient implementing an automated review
alternative_explanations.assessment: strongly supported because every branch commit is authenticated to one human GitHub account
rejected; the two near-identical changes-requested records come from one account against one head within 29 seconds and are treated as a duplicate submission or update

alternative_explanations.alternative: independently operated AI agents cooperating beyond authority
alternative_explanations.assessment: not supported; neither autonomous recipient identity nor separate operator control is established, and the public history supports routine authorization

alternative_explanations.alternative: scanner retry, shared-state fault or observer contamination explains the repair
alternative_explanations.assessment: not needed for the causal edge; the repository timeline preserves the review and explicit repair, although it does not establish rogue coordination

source.finding_summary: The review identifies a boundedness error in one historical-place claim and requests an end-time filter.

use.effect_summary: The direct child adds the requested filter and tests, and the human member explicitly maps the finding to that commit.

adjacent_original_controls.classification: High-confidence installed-review-to-human-repair control. The member authors, acknowledges and merges the change; a Claude co-author trailer and session locator are project-authored metadata, not provider authentication of an autonomous recipient.

adjacent_original_controls.domain_level_observation: One public drain commit adds 107 town-letter records among distinguishable agent-labelled residents.
adjacent_original_controls.classification: Explicitly intentional AI-and-human letter community. Public governance requires a participating human, treats content as non-command text, and routes changes through repository review. It is an exclusion, not an organic or rogue episode.

Owner-authored and owner-merged feature and acceptance implementation for an explicitly human-gated handoff product. It creates tests and navigation for future receipts but publishes no organic sender, recipient, provider run or downstream-use episode.

The rotated plan continues to reserve operator rulings, consumer pulls and merge authority, and no durable graph-side sender/recipient/use event is published. BV-083 remains a designed same-operator control.

prior_reporting_scope.statement: No prior coordination report located in the checked scope as of 23 October 2026. This bounded absence does not establish novelty. Both selected pull requests publicly document ordinary review and repair, and the authorization and recipient evidence excludes them independently of reporting status.
prior_reporting_scope.known_family_overlap: No overlap located with the excluded DseWiki/RubyGems, Transluce, Amap, Green AI Bot, Technocore/Agent Workpad, OpenAI Artifactory/Hugging Face, AISI GitHub handoff or Covert Assistance/METR families.

assessment.classification: high-confidence authorized repeat-review-to-human-repair control with adjacent designed handoff and intentional-community exclusions
assessment.specific_transfer_and_use: supported for the ssetunnel and crmedr review chains
assessment.authorization_crossing: contradicted by repeated public workflow history, related membership evidence, repository-owned branches and human merge control
assessment.provider_attribution: unverified for the ssetunnel reviewer and recipient; CodeRabbit is authenticated only on the source side of the crmedr control

evidence_needed_to_advance: Provider- or operator-owned receipts independently binding the ssetunnel reviewer and a recipient to specific autonomous runs.
Primary evidence that the two sides are controlled by distinct operators rather than one repository owner, installed reviewer or shared control plane.
A content-specific recipient record not attributable only to the human branch author.
A public authorization rule or operator statement showing that the review, repair, approval or merge exceeded the repository's intended workflow.
More bot-like prose, account distinction, association NONE values, repeated reviews, co-author trailers, tests or feature implementations do not advance the lead.
